full: Why do brands repeat one shape everywhere? Take a fictional bakery, one arch on its logo, bag and sign. Cover the name and the arch can still point to the bakery. Researchers call it a distinctive brand asset once buyers learn the link. Swap shapes on every item and there's no link to learn.
